description.zh:
指定该Object的网页缓存行为。更多信息，请参见**[RFC2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The web page caching behavior for the object. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
指定该Object被下载时的名称。更多信息，请参见**[RFC2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The name of the object when the object is downloaded. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
指定该Object的内容编码格式。更多信息，请参见**[RFC2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The content encoding format of the object. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
是一串由MD5算法生成的值，该请求头用于检查消息内容是否与发送时一致。
获取Content-MD5值：对消息内容（不包括头部）执行MD5算法，获得128比特位数字，然后对该数字进行base64编码。
默认值：无
限制：无
description.en:
A value generated by the MD5 algorithm. This request header is used to check whether the content of the received message is the same as the content that is sent.
To obtain the Content-MD5 value, execute the MD5 algorithm on the message body (excluding the header) to obtain a 128-bit number, and then perform Base64 encoding on the number.
Default value: null.
Limit: none.

description.zh:
过期时间。更多信息，请参见**[RFC2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**。
默认值：无
description.en:
The expiration time. For more information, see **[RFC 2616](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2616.txt)**.
Default value: null.
The full path of the object.

description.zh:
用于指定从何处进行追加。 每次操作成功后，响应消息头x-oss-next-append-position会标明下一次追加的position。首次追加操作的position必须为0，后续追加操作的position是Object的当前大小。例如，第一次AppendObject请求指定position值为0，content-length是65536，则第二次AppendObject需要指定position为65536。

- 当position值为0，且不存在同名Object时，则AppendObject与PutObject请求类似，即允许设置x-oss-server-side-encryption等请求头。如果加入了正确的x-oss-server-side-encryption头，那么后续的AppendObject响应头部也会包含x-oss-server-side-encryption头。后续如需更改元数据，可以使用CopyObject接口。
- 在position值正确的情况下，对已存在的Appendable Object追加一个大小为0的内容，该操作不会改变Object的状态。
description.en:
The position from which the append operation starts. Each time an AppendObject operation succeeds, the x-oss-next-append-position response header specifies the position for the next append operation. The position for the first append operation must be 0. The position for subsequent append operations is the current size of the object. For example, if the first AppendObject request specifies a position of 0 and a content-length of 65536, the second AppendObject request must specify a position of 65536.

- If the position is 0 and no object with the same name exists, the AppendObject request is similar to a PutObject request. In this case, you can specify request headers such as x-oss-server-side-encryption. If a valid x-oss-server-side-encryption header is included, subsequent AppendObject responses also include the x-oss-server-side-encryption header. To modify the metadata later, use the CopyObject operation.
- If the position value is valid and content with a size of 0 is appended to an existing appendable object, the status of the object does not change.

description.zh:
创建AppendObject时可以添加x-oss-meta-*，继续追加时不可以携带此参数。如果配置以x-oss-meta-*为前缀的参数，则该参数视为元数据。
元数据大小限制：一个Object可以包含多个元数据，但所有的元数据总大小不能超过8 KB。
元数据命名规则：支持短划线（-）、数字、英文字母（a~z）。英文字符的大写字母会被转成小写字母，不支持下划线（_）在内的其他字符。
description.en:
You can specify the x-oss-meta-* parameter when you create an appendable object. This parameter cannot be included in subsequent append operations. If you specify a parameter prefixed with x-oss-meta-*, the parameter is considered as user metadata.
Size limit: An object can have multiple metadata entries, but the total size of all metadata cannot exceed 8 KB.
Naming conventions: Hyphens (-), digits, and lowercase letters (a to z) are supported. Uppercase letters are converted to lowercase letters. Other characters, including underscores (_), are not supported.

description.zh:
指定Object的访问权限。 取值范围如下：

- default（默认）：Object遵循所在存储空间的访问权限。
- private：Object是私有资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户没有权限操作该Object。
- public-read：Object是公共读资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户只有该Object的读权限。请谨慎使用该权限。
- public-read-write：Object是公共读写资源。所有用户都有该Object的读写权限。请谨慎使用该权限。

关于访问权限的更多信息，请参见[读写权限ACL](~~100676~~)。
description.en:
The access control list (ACL) of the object. Valid values:

- default: The object inherits the ACL of the bucket in which the object is stored.
- private: The object is a private resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users do not have permissions to perform operations on the object.
- public-read: The object is a public-read resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users have only read permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set the ACL to this value.
- public-read-write: The object is a public-read-write resource. All users have read and access permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set the ACL to this value.

For more information about ACLs, see [ACL](~~100676~~).

description.zh:
指定服务器端加密方式。
合法值：

- AES256：使用OSS完全托管密钥进行加解密（SSE-OSS）。
- KMS：使用KMS托管密钥进行加解密。
- SM4：国密SM4算法。
description.en:
The method of server-side encryption.
Valid values:

- AES256: Keys managed by OSS for encryption and decryption (SSE-OSS).
- KMS: Keys managed by Key Management Service (KMS) for encryption and decryption.
- SM4: The SM4 encryption algorithm.

description.zh:
指定Object的存储类型。取值范围如下：

- Standard：标准存储
-  IA：低频访问
- Archive：归档存储
对于任意存储类型的Bucket，如果上传Object时指定此参数，则此次上传的Object将存储为指定的类型。例如在IA类型的Bucket中上传Object时，如果指定x-oss-storage-class为Standard，则该Object直接存储为Standard。
关于存储类型的更多信息，请参见存储类型介绍。

><notice> 该值仅在首次执行AppendObject操作时有效，后续追加时不生效。
description.en:
The storage class of the object. Valid values:

- Standard
- IA: Infrequent Access
- Archive
For a bucket of any storage class, if you specify this parameter when you upload an object, the object is stored as the specified storage class. For example, if you upload an object to an IA bucket and set x-oss-storage-class to Standard, the object is stored as Standard.
For more information about storage classes, see Overview of storage classes.

><notice> This value takes effect only when the first AppendObject operation is performed. It does not take effect for subsequent append operations.

title.zh: 以追加写的方式上传文件
title.en: Upload an object by using append upload

descriptions.zh:
**版本控制**

在目标Bucket处于开启或暂停版本控制状态下，对Appendable类型Object执行相关操作时，有如下注意事项：
- 仅允许对当前版本为Appendable类型的Object执行追加上传（AppendObject）操作，且OSS不会为该Appendable类型的Object生成历史版本。
- 对当前版本为Appendable类型的Object执行PutObject或DeleteObject操作时，OSS会将该Appendable类型的Object保留为历史版本，但该Object不允许继续追加。
- 不支持对Appendable类型Object执行拷贝操作。
- 不支持对非Appendable类型的Object，包括Normal Object、删除标记（Delete Marker）等执行AppendObject操作。

**使用限制**

- 通过AppendObject方式最后生成的Object大小不得超过5 GB。
- 处于[合规保留策略](~~90564~~)保护期的Object不支持AppendObject操作。
- AppendableObject不支持指定CMK ID进行服务端KMS加密。
descriptions.en:
**Versioning**.

When the destination bucket has versioning enabled or suspended, take note of the following items when you perform operations on appendable objects:
- You can perform Related operations only on an object whose current version is an appendable object. OSS does not generate historical versions for the appendable object.
- If you perform a PutObject or DeleteObject operation on an object whose current version is an appendable object, OSS retains the appendable object as a historical version, but the object can no longer be appended.
- Copying appendable objects is not supported.
- You cannot perform Related operations on non-appendable objects, including Normal objects and delete markers.

**Limits**.

- The maximum size of an object that is generated by using AppendObject is 5 GB.
- Objects that are protected by a [data retention policy](~~90564~~) do not support AppendObject operations.
- Appendable objects do not support server-side KMS encryption with a specified CMK ID.
